tasks.spec: You are the CONTRARIAN lane of a read-only architecture red-team. You may READ /mnt/d_drive/repos/loop-factory, /mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast, /mnt/d_drive/repos/EA, and the five evidence reports under /mnt/d_drive/ringer-work/loop-brain-reconcile/*/report.md. NEVER create, modify, or delete files in those locations; write ONLY in your current working directory. Never read files matching *credentials*, *token*, *secret*, *.env, *.key. No network, no MCP, no skills; finish autonomously. THE PROPOSED ARCHITECTURE you must attack (v1, 'The Conductor') evolves loop-factory with four components. (4) RUN-MANIFESTS + BLOCKING RECONCILIATION: before the first node of any department run, an immutable state/run-manifests/<run_id>.json is minted from a release-owned template listing ordinal, node_id, expected_artifacts with validators (hash/schema/freshness/nonzero), required_predecessors, and optional signed skip contracts; every node emits a run-bound produced record (emit failure becomes fatal); a pure set-and-order diff runs inside the department manager cycle between Sense and Compare; any missing/invalid/reordered entry blocks approvals/heals/rotation/boards for that run and escalates; the '|| true' bypass at departments/podcast/runtime/podcast_daily.sh:127 is removed. (1) CLIEF-NOTES DEPARTMENT SURFACE: the factory scaffold emits per department an AGENTS.md master control (CLAUDE.md three-line pointer), ROUTER.md mapping a task to exactly one numbered stage folder (unknown route stops), floors.yaml, numbered stage folders each holding CONTEXT.md (Inputs labeled L3/L4, Process, Outputs, Verify), references/ with half-life stamps, output/ run artifacts consumed by the next stage, plus state/events.jsonl as an append-only cohort transition ledger. (2) GOAL/FLOOR COMPILER: charter.yaml (humans only) gains end_goals (e.g., discovery_calls_per_week: 10) and a stage transition schema with prior conversion rates; a deterministic floor_compiler.py derives flow floors ceil(downstream/rate*(1+buffer)) and stock floors via Little's Law, updates weekly from matured 4-week cohorts (min samples 30 entrants / 10 conversions, blend 0.75 old + 0.25 new, deadband 90-105 percent, two-review hysteresis, 20 percent max weekly change), and writes floors.yaml. Owner decision: floor changes are FULL AUTO with alarm-after, but caps (12 outbound/day, 5 new contacts/day, zero dollars), external-send gates, and charter values stay kernel/human-gated; a derived floor conflicting with a cap escalates instead of overriding. (3) CONDUCTOR: deterministic factory/conductor.py replaces the hard-coded shell pipeline as the driver: each tick it reconciles run-manifest vs receipts, picks the highest-priority eligible transition (unblock > floor-gap > routine), dispatches through kernel gateways to headless subscription workers (Codex/Claude/Ringer), verifies the receipt, advances; a stall goes to the heal ladder then a human card with a recheck deadline. It may never act without a manifest entry, bypass a gateway, or edit governance files. Existing machinery is unchanged: kernel gateways, signed step receipts (finally placed on the production path), releases/drift, promotion ladder, estate watchdog, heal ladder, always-human charter floor. Two departments: podcast retrofit, plus a fresh discovery-call sales funnel (prospecting, outreach, conversations, close-nervous, discovery call; goal 10/week). YOUR JOB: find what is wrong, brittle, overbuilt, missing, or self-contradictory. Attack at least: whether the conductor recreates the split-brain the procedural graph forbids (a second scheduler beside manager/estate); whether the folder surface duplicates truth already held in procedural-graph.md and subgraphs.json and how the two drift; whether immutable pre-run manifests fit event-driven work (webhook replies, human calls) or only batch runs; whether full-auto floor changes plus alarm-after can compound a bad measured rate into runaway activity before a human looks; whether the retrofit cost onto podcast is justified versus its existing F00-F19 graph; and anything the five evidence reports contradict in this design. DELIVERABLES in your working directory: packet.json with EXACTLY these keys: agent ('codex-contrarian'), recommendation (string, 10+ words), confidence (0..1), evidence (list, 3+), assumptions (list), unique_catches (list, 5+ — your best original objections, each concrete and testable), risks_or_failure_modes (list, 3+), proof_slots (list, 2+ — what executed check would confirm or kill each major objection), needs_human_or_owner_gate (boolean). And findings.md, 400+ words, arguing your catches with at least 5 citations to real files (repo paths or the report.md files).
tasks.verified: Contrarian packet parses with 5+ concrete catches and cited findings; objections are testable, not vibes.

You may READ /mnt/d_drive/repos/loop-factory, /mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast, /mnt/d_drive/repos/EA, and the five evidence reports under /mnt/d_drive/ringer-work/loop-brain-reconcile/*/report.md. No network, no MCP, no skills; finish autonomously. THE HARD RULES that must survive (from loop-factory CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md): shadow-first for every new action class; deny-by-default (missing/hollow/stale/forged/replayed/mistagged receipt BLOCKS, gateway error REFUSES); always-human floor (charters, autonomy states, promotion thresholds, runbooks are humans-only; heals and managers may never modify a safety invariant); process change = map change + QA + re-pin; records always; no secrets/PHI in department code or records; receipt-gated steps; headless subscription-only engines. THE PROPOSED ARCHITECTURE (v1, 'The Conductor') adds: (4) immutable per-run manifests minted before the first node from a release-owned template, run-bound produced records with fatal emit failure, and a blocking set-and-order diff in the manager (nonempty diff blocks approvals/heals/rotation/boards); (1) a per-department clief-notes surface: AGENTS.md master, ROUTER.md, floors.yaml, numbered stage folders with CONTEXT.md contracts, half-life references, output/ chaining, state/events.jsonl cohort ledger; (2) a deterministic floor compiler: charter end_goals plus transition priors derive flow/stock floors, updated weekly from matured cohorts with hysteresis; floor changes are FULL AUTO with alarm-after, while caps (12 outbound/day, 5 new contacts/day, zero dollars), external-send gates, and charter values stay kernel/human-gated, and a floor conflicting with a cap escalates instead of overriding; (3) a deterministic conductor that reconciles, picks the next eligible transition, dispatches through kernel gateways to headless subscription workers, verifies receipts, and advances, never acting without a manifest entry, never bypassing a gateway, never editing governance files. YOUR JOB: enumerate concrete abuse/violation paths and rank them. Attack at least: can the floor compiler + conductor combination cause or launder EXTERNAL effects without a promotion (e.g., a floor-gap dispatch that a worker satisfies by sending; a heal that edits floors.yaml; boards or cards that leak guest PII from events.jsonl); can a forged, hollow, or replayed run-manifest or a permissive skip contract authorize skipping (who signs manifests, where does the template live, can a worker write state/run-manifests/); can the conductor's retry budget plus full-auto floors create unbounded activity ramp inside caps that still burns the model-call budget or spams humans; can machine-written floors.yaml drift into a de facto governance file that heals DO touch (violating the always-human floor by relocation of authority); can the events.jsonl ledger be poisoned to game measured conversion rates and thereby lower floors or inflate them; and does putting reconciliation inside the manager create a single component whose compromise both hides and approves (who watches the reconciler). For each path: preconditions, the rule it would violate, blast radius, and the deterministic check or design change that closes it.
